description: AirfoilPreppy is the national-laboratory WISDEM team's Python tool for preparing aerodynamic airfoil data for wind turbines. It contains three-dimensional rotational corrections, extrapolation to large angles of attack and blending between airfoil sections. Inputs are two-dimensional wind-tunnel or numerical aerodynamic data; outputs include corrected aerodynamic tables and AeroDyn-format files. Coverage is the supplied airfoil and operating-angle range, with no fixed geographic or historical coverage. Source is free under Apache-2.0, confirmed in the repository licence. A limitation is that the documented Python implementation does not handle pitching-moment coefficients included in the older spreadsheet version. The methods are simplified preprocessing relations, not a full flow solver. The package supports turbine-performance and blade-element momentum simulations. WindSE (platform-windse) is a related wind-farm modelling tool. The provider's introduction was read through GitHub after the documentation website failed to open.
